summary.text: Tommy Tuberville is Alabama's senior U.S. senator and a former college football head coach, including at Auburn University from 1999 to 2008. First elected in 2020 when he defeated Sen. Doug Jones, he is running for governor on an 'Alabama First Agenda' of cutting taxes and government waste, expanding school choice, protecting Second Amendment rights and tougher border enforcement.

paragraphs.text: Born in Camden, Arkansas; earned a B.S. in physical education from Southern State College (now Southern Arkansas University) in 1976.
Head football coach at Ole Miss (1995–1998), Auburn (1999–2008), Texas Tech (2010–2012) and Cincinnati (2013–2016).
Elected to the U.S. Senate in 2020, defeating incumbent Democrat Doug Jones; his first political campaign.
